# QAcover — Software QA Testing & Test Automation

> QAcover is an independent software quality engineering company specializing in manual exploratory testing, Playwright & Cypress test automation, and white-label QA for high-velocity software teams, startups, and development agencies.

## Overview & Core Offerings
- **Manual Exploratory QA**: Human-led exploratory bug hunts, boundary value analysis, regression sign-offs, and usability testing across real physical devices (iOS, Android, macOS, Windows).
- **Test Automation Services**: Robust, maintainable end-to-end regression test suites engineered in Playwright, Cypress, and Appium with TypeScript/Python. CI/CD integration with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and CircleCI.
- **Playwright Test Automation**: Dedicated Playwright test framework implementation, parallel worker execution, trace viewer diagnostics, and auto-waiting stability.
- **Mobile App QA**: Testing native and cross-platform iOS and Android applications across physical device matrices under fluctuating network conditions.
- **API & Backend Testing**: Validating REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication flows, payload schemas, and backend response times.
- **White-Label QA for Agencies**: Turnkey quality assurance for dev shops, SaaS agencies, and design studios delivered under strict white-label NDA.
- **Chandigarh Tricity QA**: Local senior QA partner serving the Chandigarh IT corridor (IT Park Chandigarh, Mohali Sector 67/82/QuarkCity, Panchkula, and Zirakpur) as well as product teams worldwide.

## Key Policies & Turnaround
- **Free Flow Audit**: 1 key user flow tested on real devices with a prioritized bug report delivered within 3 business days under mutual NDA.
- **Response SLA**: 1 business day response (IST) with daily sprint overlap for US, UK/Europe, and APAC timezones.
- **Confidentiality**: Bilateral Mutual NDA, zero retention of production client data, and complete client IP ownership.
